title: Model factory with arch metadata
description: New src/model_factory.py: build_model(arch, num_classes=2, pretrained) returning 'resnet18' (torchvision, classifier head swapped for 2 classes) or 'custom' (EggGradingCNN). Write arch into checkpoint metadata (arch, arch_args). Offline fallback: if pretrained weight download fails, warn + random init. Single source of truth for arch names shared by train/eval/backend.
acceptance_criteria: build_model('resnet18') returns torchvision model with 2-class head
Pretrained download failure falls back to random init with warning (no crash)
